id: Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald (2018)

facts.why: The venue and ticket say Cirque Arcanus, but this dish says Circus Arcanus. Wikipedia uses Circus Arcanus, so the film's spelling is unclear and the menu should pick one.

vibe.verdict: The circus ticket and Paris pastries work well, though it skips the film's best creature and spell moments.
